svg.title: Bottleneck Migration Network
svg.desc: A single network diagram organized by four industry domains and four bottleneck depths, showing how replication pressure migrates from confirmed bottlenecks into direct inputs, process capacity, and shared physical constraints, and where demand can move onto substitute paths.
svg.text: Columns measure replication distance from a confirmed bottleneck; rows keep every branch at the same industry-domain level.

g.text: Depth is relative. When a D1 node turns red, it becomes the new D0 and the map is measured again.
